M Checkpoint (Mitosis) Purpose: This is where the cell actually divides into two new cells. Check: The cell checks if the chromosomes are lined up correctly and ready to be separated. Decision: If everything is in order, the cell completes division. If there are problems, it might stop and try to fix things before moving on. This checkpoint is associated with the Metaphase stage in mitosis. If chromosomes aren't aligned, the cell may enter metaphase arrest or apoptosis.
